name: kb-verify
description: Verifies knowledge-base articles against the code of a GitHub repository, read-only through the gh API, and emits CORRECT | DOC_OUTDATED | CODE_BUG | INCONCLUSIVE with path:line@commit evidence. CODE_BUG writes a bug MD for human triage; DOC_OUTDATED writes a proposed diff next to the article. A PreToolUse guard enforces read-only behaviour.
